a pair whose pages were exhausted behaves exactly as today; proven by diff tests for both cases\u0022,\u0022DiffRenderer prints the new reason like the others, the end-of-walk Gone count line says how many rows are beyond the cap when any are, and the per-pair summary line says \\u0027capped\\u0027 when the pair stopped short; the walk\\u0027s existing tests over the recorded fixtures pass; docs/walk.md (or the README\\u0027s Gone-reasons text if the docs split has not landed) lists the fifth reason; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-59 at the end of walk run 5 on 2026-09-26 (notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md, Gaps found; output notes/walk-2026-09-26.txt): the walk collected 60 links (twice the cap of 30) on carvana Camry Hybrid (149 stated) and Corolla Hybrid (59 stated) and stopped paging, then reported every known carvana posting outside those 60 as Gone \\u0027not on search page\\u0027 (carvana Corolla Hybrid 8, Camry Hybrid 6, Prius 5, Insight 4; cars.com Camry Hybrid 5, Corolla Hybrid 3, Prius 2), so 33 Gone rows this run are mostly cars still for sale. PR #53 (5bdae3aa) made the walk uncapped by default, which removes the cause for a bare walk, but an explicit --max still produces it and the diff must stay honest. Code: src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkSearchPages.cs CollectLinksAsync stops on pool full, no new links, the stated-count bound (linkBound), or the exhausted-search marker, and knows which; src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkCoverage.cs stamps the run\\u0027s coverage token per pair (RunEntity.Sources, one source:model token per pair, see RunSources); src/Odonomics/Ledger/LedgerDiffService.cs computes Gone per token (line 213 onward) with GoneReasons.BelowYearFacet, OverMileage, SearchMoved, NotOnSearchPage in that precedence; DiffRenderer.cs prints the Gone table with its Reason column. No \\u0027N matches\\u0027 count text exists in the page body, so MatchCountPattern stays null for cars.com and the stop rule is the carvana form. 238da0a2 (PR #52) added page_size=100 on the orchestrator\\u0027s unverified guess with the explicit instruction to drop it if the site ignored it; this task is that drop, blocked on 238da0a2 merging.
